newsitem.title: USA: Bridgeport sees future sales level with Q3.
newsitem.headline: Bridgeport sees future sales level with Q3.

text.p: Bridgeport Machines Inc said Thursday it expects sales levels in the fourth quarter of this year and the first quarter of fiscal 1998 to be about the same as those reported in the third quarter.
Bridgeport on Thursday reported sales for the third quarter of fiscal 1997 of $59.8 million, compared with $56.8 million in the third quarter of fiscal 1996.
The company said third quarter results were hurt by soft conditions in Europe which resulted in pricing pressure, as well as cancellation of some future orders from distributors.
It said, however, results were in line with expectations.
Bridgeport said it believes distributors' forward orders in Europe are now adjusted to reflect market conditions.
It said incoming orders should "begin to reflect current shipping levels, although price competition will continue."
Domestic margins should "improve somewhat in conjunction with the end of the manual mill promotion in December and a price increase on the EZ-Surf Grinder," the company added.
The company reported third quarter net income of $1.94 million, or $0.34 per share, compared with net income in the 1996 third quarter of $2.99 million, or $0.52 per share.
